subject.title: Feature: configurable mediaLocalRoots for image tool

question: Should OpenClaw accept a general operator-configured host-local root allowlist for image/media reads, and should that contract be the broader `tools.fs.roots` policy from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/52951 or a narrower media-only setting?
rationale: This changes a model-facing filesystem read boundary and config surface; code inspection shows the remaining work is policy selection, not a missing one-line implementation.

options.title: Adopt shared `tools.fs.roots`
options.body: Use the open broader filesystem-root contract as the canonical policy for host-mode FS tools and media reads, with schema, docs, upgrade, and security tests.

options.title: Design media-only roots
options.body: Add a narrower media-root allowlist only if maintainers want image/PDF/webchat media reads decoupled from general filesystem tools.

options.title: Decline broad host roots
options.body: Keep safe defaults plus scoped channel inbound roots, and document copy/symlink/workspace workflows for arbitrary external files.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared `tools.fs.roots`
recommendation.body: Use the open broader filesystem-root contract as the canonical policy for host-mode FS tools and media reads, with schema, docs, upgrade, and security tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the most recent visible owner on the current media-root resolver and also authored the earlier iMessage/media-root repair attempt.
